causes.regenerator: Regenerator's heal on switch-out is never logged, so an opposing benched mon's HP is stale (poke-env estimates it when it knows the ability, off by Showdown's 99% rounding)
causes.healing-wish: a pending Healing Wish or Lunar Dance (a slot condition) isn't tracked
causes.future-sight-silent: a pending Future Sight is kept after it ends without a message (its target fainted first)
causes.toxic-cap: the toxic counter isn't capped at 15 as the sim's stage is
causes.pkmn-duplicate-slots: each request duplicates the own active's move slots (rememberMove compares `virtual` with the request slots' undefined)
causes.pkmn-z: Z-Moves: no Z-used state (`-zpower` is unhandled), and a Z-Move is recorded among the mon's moves under its Z name
causes.pkmn-mega: no Mega-used state; derived from the side's formes, it is lost when a fainted Mega reverts
causes.pkmn-heal-reset: any `-heal` without `[from]` (Roost, Recover, Leech Seed's silent heal) runs the Healing Wish branch and zeroes the sleep and toxic counters
causes.pkmn-locked-moves: the own active's move list is emptied when the request lists only a move without PP (a locked move, recharge or Struggle)
causes.pkmn-roost: Roost's volatile is kept only for Flying users, where it has an effect
causes.pokeenv-activations: one-off events (`-activate`, `-singleturn`: Supreme Overlord, Tera Shell, Psychic Terrain's block, Endure, ...) are stored as effects and some are never cleared
causes.pokeenv-forme: `species` keeps the pre-change name after Mega Evolution and other forme changes (types, base stats and ability do change)
causes.pokeenv-toxic-turns: the toxic counter moves at `|turn|`, not at the poison damage, so it is one off for a mon that came in after a faint and at decisions between the residual and the next turn
causes.pokeenv-rest: the counter carries over when Rest replaces toxic
causes.pokeenv-future-sight-user: a pending Future Sight is an effect on its user, lost when the user switches out or faints
causes.illusion-hidden: Illusion, while it holds: the disguise's entry gets the Zoroark's HP, status, boosts and moves
causes.illusion-after: Illusion, after `|replace|` breaks it: what was attributed to the disguise stays on the wrong entry (tagged by game: any mismatch no other rule explains, at a decision after an Illusion held in that game)
